records.source: Fisherman: I came all the way from Grampleton for this.||Fisherman: I'm not leaving without a bag full of trout!
records.translation: Mangingisda: Galing pa ako sa Grampleton para rito.||Mangingisda: Hindi ako aalis nang walang sakong puno ng trutsa!

records.source: Mariner: I think I'm a little overdressed for this event.
records.translation: Marinero: Sa tingin ko, medyo sobra ang porma ko para sa kaganapang ito.

records.source: Mariner: Of course... some guy shows up wearing the same outfit as me. How embarassing!
records.translation: Marinero: Siyempre... may lalaking dumating na kapareho ko ang suot. Nakakahiya!

records.source: Fisherman: Excuse me, I'm trying to enjoy the peace and quiet.||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: Can't you take a hint?||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: Someone's about to get battered, and it ain't the trout.||Fisherman:...
records.translation: Mangingisda: Paumanhin, sinusubukan kong tamasahin ang katahimikan.||Mangingisda: ...||Mangingisda: ...||Mangingisda: ...||Mangingisda: Hindi ka ba marunong makiramdam?||Mangingisda: ...||Mangingisda: ...||Mangingisda: ...||Mangingisda: May mabubugbog dito, at hindi iyon ang trutsa.||Mangingisda:...

records.source: Fishing Sisters: We're the famous fishing sisters!||Fishing Sisters: We'll fish as many fish as we wish! Nah Nah Nah!
records.translation: Magkapatid na Mangingisda: Kami ang sikat na magkapatid na mangingisda!||Magkapatid na Mangingisda: Manghuhuli kami ng isda hanggang magsawa! La la la!

records.source: Angler: Any luck? Most of the bites I'm getting are from the mosquitos...
records.translation: Mangingisda: May suwerte ba? Karamihan sa kumakagat sa akin ay mga lamok...

records.source: Trout Man: Where I come from, they call me 'Trout Man'.||Trout Man: Yep, I spent five years learning how to think like a trout. Pretty simple, actually: food, food, food, lay eggs, rest, eat more food.||Trout Man: I happen to like food, myself. Not so good at laying eggs, though.
records.translation: Lalaking Trutsa: Sa amin, tinatawag nila akong “Lalaking Trutsa”.||Lalaking Trutsa: Oo, limang taon kong pinag-aralan kung paano mag-isip na parang trutsa. Simple lang pala: pagkain, pagkain, pagkain, mangitlog, magpahinga, kumain pa.||Lalaking Trutsa: Mahilig din ako sa pagkain. Hindi lang ako magaling mangitlog.

records.source: Fisherman: Trying to get away from the crowds? I had the same idea.
records.translation: Mangingisda: Lumalayo ka ba sa mga tao? Iyan din ang naisip ko.

records.source: Fishing Pro: I know it's not a competition, but still... whoever gets the most tags will have bragging rights for the rest of the year!||Fishing Pro: I'll be back in winter for SquidFest... Now that's a real challenge!||Fishing Pro: The secret to catching trout is, you gotta give them a presentation that looks so delicious, they can't help but take a bite...
records.translation: Propesyonal na Mangingisda: Alam kong hindi ito paligsahan, pero... sinumang makakuha ng pinakamaraming tatak ang may maipagmamalaki sa buong taon!||Propesyonal na Mangingisda: Babalik ako sa taglamig para sa Pista ng Pusit... Iyon ang totoong hamon!||Propesyonal na Mangingisda: Ang sikreto sa paghuli ng trutsa ay maghain ng pain na napakasarap tingnan kaya hindi nila mapigilang kumagat...

records.source: Fisherman: Ah, now this is the life. Nothing is more tranquil than a day of trout fishing.
records.translation: Mangingisda: Ah, ito ang buhay. Walang mas payapa kaysa sa isang araw ng panghuhuli ng trutsa.

records.source: Fisherman: Squid usually only show up at night. But they threw some special bait in the water that's making them active all day.
records.translation: Mangingisda: Karaniwang sa gabi lang lumilitaw ang pusit. Pero naglagay sila ng espesyal na pain sa tubig kaya aktibo ang mga ito buong araw.

records.source: Mariner: The cold air makes me feel tough, like a piece of jerky.||Mariner: When the air is too warm I feel like a pudding.
records.translation: Marinero: Sa malamig na hangin, pakiramdam ko'y matigas ako, parang pinatuyong karne.||Marinero: Kapag masyadong mainit ang hangin, para naman akong puding.

records.source: Mariner: Come here, squiddy squiddy...
records.translation: Marinero: Halika rito, pusit, pusit...

records.source: Fisherman: You're a local, huh? Hope you don't mind if I pinch a few of your fine squid...
records.translation: Mangingisda: Taga-rito ka, ano? Sana ayos lang na manghuli ako ng ilan sa magaganda ninyong pusit...

records.source: Fishing Sisters: We're the famous fishing sisters.||Fishing Sisters: We've been fishing squids since we were kids. Nah nah nah!
records.translation: Magkapatid na Mangingisda: Kami ang sikat na magkapatid na mangingisda.||Magkapatid na Mangingisda: Bata pa kami, nangingisda na kami ng pusit. La la la!

records.source: Angler: Brrr... It's cold! Maybe I'm not cut out for winter ocean fishing.||Angler: I'm more of a CarpFest kind of guy...
records.translation: Mangingisda: Brrr... Ang lamig! Baka hindi talaga para sa akin ang pangingisda sa karagatan tuwing taglamig.||Mangingisda: Mas bagay sa akin ang Pista ng Karpa...

records.source: Trout Man: Welp, squid are a bit different than trout, but I can catch them all the same.||Trout Man: You better get to fishing if you want a shot at the prize!
records.translation: Lalaking Trutsa: Aba, medyo iba ang pusit sa trutsa, pero mahuhuli ko rin ang mga iyon.||Lalaking Trutsa: Dapat mangisda ka na kung gusto mong magkaroon ng pagkakataon sa premyo!

records.source: Fisherman: My wife sent me off with a thermos of hot coffee. What a gal!
records.translation: Mangingisda: Pinabaunan ako ng asawa ko ng termos ng mainit na kape. Napakabuti niya!

records.source: Fishing Pro: Shhh... I don't want to scare the squid.||Fishing Pro: I came over here to get away from the crowd. Squid can be shy.||Fishing Pro: You can fish here if you want, though. Just try to be quiet.
records.translation: Propesyonal na Mangingisda: Shhh... Ayaw kong matakot ang pusit.||Propesyonal na Mangingisda: Lumipat ako rito para lumayo sa mga tao. Maaaring mahiyain ang pusit.||Propesyonal na Mangingisda: Puwede kang mangisda rito kung gusto mo. Subukan mo lang manahimik.

records.source: Fisherman: I'm not too worried about winning the competition. I just want to enjoy the ambience.||Fisherman: Summer's weather is nicer, but there's something special about a rugged winter. And what would life be without contrast?
records.translation: Mangingisda: Hindi ako masyadong nag-aalala sa pagkapanalo. Gusto ko lang tamasahin ang paligid.||Mangingisda: Mas maganda ang panahon sa tag-init, pero may natatangi sa malupit na taglamig. At ano ang buhay kung walang pagkakaiba?

records.source: Fisherman: My fingers are frozen solid, so I'm just going to enjoy a hot cup o' cider over here. Good luck out there!
records.translation: Mangingisda: Nanigas sa lamig ang mga daliri ko, kaya iinom na lang ako rito ng isang tasang mainit na sidra. Suwertehin ka sana riyan!

records.source: Squid Chef: Oh, don't mind me... I'm just here for the bulk squid prices!||Squid Chef: Well, what are you waiting for? Those squid aren't going to catch themselves!
records.translation: Kusinerong Pusit: Ah, huwag mo akong alalahanin... Narito lang ako para sa presyong pakyawan sa pusit!||Kusinerong Pusit: Aba, ano pa ang hinihintay mo? Hindi kusang mahuhuli ang mga pusit na iyan!
